title: Opportunity of a Life Time! (These 6 Stocks Could PRINT Millions Soon)
creator: BWB - Business With Brian
summary: Brian (Business With Brian) joins Professor G (Investing Simplified) to answer the classic 'only 3 stocks' question, landing on 6 total (3 each). The bulk is macro framing: Brian argues AI is still in 'the first 2 minutes of the football game', with edge computing as the next investable stack after cloud/data centers; he is constructive even though a correction feels overdue ('a house of cards' on valuations, but AI demand is a safety net). He is bearish on big IPOs (SpaceX, Anthropic) as 'fully baked pies' for insiders, preferring exposure via big-tech backers. On portfolio defense, he holds 2 years' spending in bonds at retirement, never times the market, and doubled down into mega caps in the 2022 -32% drawdown. Brian's three picks: Nvidia (90% AI chip share, 60% operating margins, edge/robotics/quantum-software optionality, 10-year trajectory), Broadcom ('the muscle' to Nvidia's 'brains', custom hyperscaler chips + VMware cash cow, revenue +92%), Vertiv (data-center cooling, 23% global share, backlog +77% YoY). Professor G's three (host-only, not Brian's calls): Alphabet ('super undervalued'), IonQ (speculative quantum bet, 'could go to zero'), Berkshire Hathaway (~$400B cash for a crash). Calls: NVDA, AVGO, VRT BUY (Brian). Note: some fragmented sentences in the AI-framing section.
